quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #22
										  					
  

20 Questions • Passing Score 16

questions.question: What should you do when you see a steady green arrow?

options.text: You must move into the lane that points in the direction of the arrow.
You must slow down and stop if it is safe.
You can turn in the direction of the arrow. First, let other vehicles and pedestrians in the intersection pass.
You can drive straight through the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can turn in the direction of the arrow. First, let other vehicles and pedestrians in the intersection pass.
questions.explanation: A green arrow means you can turn in that direction. You must be in the correct lane. Always let other vehicles and pedestrians pass first.

questions.question: A solid white line on the right side of the road angles toward the center. What does this mean?

options.text: There is an intersection ahead.
You are approaching a construction zone.
You will need to turn left soon.
The road is getting narrower.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is getting narrower.
questions.explanation: A solid line on the edge of the road marks where the road ends. If the line angles toward the middle, the road is becoming narrower ahead.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a steady yellow arrow?

options.text: You must move into the lane that points in the direction of the arrow.
You should slow down and stop if it is safe.
You can turn left. First, let oncoming traffic and pedestrians pass.
You have the right-of-way. Oncoming traffic must stop for you.

questions.correctAnswerText: You should slow down and stop if it is safe.
questions.explanation: A steady yellow arrow warns you that a red arrow is coming next. Stop your vehicle unless you are already in the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No right turn allowed.
You must turn right.
Watch for traffic on your right.
Do not park on the right side of the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: No right turn allowed.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through it means something is not allowed. This sign shows a right turn is not allowed.

questions.question: What is the minimum jail time for a first DUI conviction?

options.text: Three days
10 days
20 hours
96 hours

questions.correctAnswerText: Three days
questions.explanation: A first DUI conviction requires jail time. The minimum is three days. You will also pay fines and fees.

questions.question: When can you cross a solid yellow line?

options.text: To pass other traffic moving in the same direction.
Only during the day.
At any time.
When you are making a turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you are making a turn.
questions.explanation: You can cross broken lines, but not solid lines. You can only cross a solid yellow line when turning.

questions.question: What do pennant-shaped signs mean?

options.text: School zones.
No passing zones.
Speed limits.
Railroad crossings.

questions.correctAnswerText: No passing zones.
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs mark no passing zones. The sign will have words to confirm this.

questions.question: You are in the left lane and want to move to the right lane. What should you do?

options.text: Check your mirrors, signal, and look over your left shoulder before changing lanes.
Check your mirrors, signal, and look over your right shoulder before changing lanes.
Check your mirrors, signal, and look over both shoulders before changing lanes.
Check your mirrors, signal, and change lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check your mirrors, signal, and look over your right shoulder before changing lanes.
questions.explanation: Look over your shoulder in the direction you want to go to check for blind spots. Always check your mirrors and signal before changing lanes.

questions.question: Why should you be careful when passing a bicycle?

options.text: Your car is faster than the bicycle.
The bicycle always has the right-of-way.
Oncoming traffic may not see you pass.
The cyclist may suddenly swerve to avoid something on the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: The cyclist may suddenly swerve to avoid something on the road.
questions.explanation: Be careful when passing a bicycle because the cyclist might suddenly swerve into traffic to avoid an object on the road. Always drive carefully around bicyclists.

questions.question: When parking downhill on a two-way street, what should you do with your wheels?

options.text: Turn your wheels to the right.
Turn your wheels to the left.
Keep your wheels straight.
Leave your transmission in neutral.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your wheels to the right.
questions.explanation: When parking downhill, turn your wheels toward the side of the road. If your car rolls, it will roll away from traffic.

questions.question: What does Alaska require for each registered vehicle?

options.text: One license plate on the back.
Two license plates: one on the front and one on the back.
No specific number of license plates.
One license plate on the front.

questions.correctAnswerText: One license plate on the back.
questions.explanation: You must have one license plate on the back of your vehicle with month and year tabs. The plate must have a white light so the numbers can be seen from at least 50 feet away.

questions.question: What does a speed restriction sign show?

options.text: It can be ignored in rain, snow, or ice.
It has a triangular shape.
It is blue with black letters.
It shows a recommended speed for curves or turns.

questions.correctAnswerText: It shows a recommended speed for curves or turns.
questions.explanation: Curve and turn warning signs show a recommended speed for that area. You can drive faster in good weather, but never drive faster than the advisory speed when roads are wet, snowy, or icy.

questions.question: If you are convicted of DUI, your license will be revoked for at least how long?

options.text: 30 days.
60 days.
Six months.
90 days.

questions.correctAnswerText: 90 days.
questions.explanation: If you refuse a breath test or your blood alcohol level is 0.08% or higher, your license will be revoked for at least 90 days.

questions.question: What happens if you are convicted of reckless driving?

options.text: A $50 fine and four points on your driving record.
A warning for the first offense and a $50 fine for the second.
Suspension of your driving privileges.
Revocation of your driving privileges.

questions.correctAnswerText: Revocation of your driving privileges.
questions.explanation: Reckless driving means driving in a way that ignores the safety of people and property. A conviction results in your license being revoked.

questions.question: Which statement is NOT true?

options.text: Driving at high speeds causes tire wear.
Driving at the same speed all the time causes boredom and road hypnosis.
Driving at high speeds uses more gasoline.
You may not drive below the posted speed limit.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may not drive below the posted speed limit.
questions.explanation: High speeds wear out tires and use more gas. Changing your speed helps prevent boredom and road hypnosis. You do not have to drive at the posted speed limit. Just do not drive so slowly that you block traffic.

questions.question: What is the maximum fine for not restraining a passenger under 16 in a moving vehicle?

options.text: $100 per passenger.
$50 per passenger.
$15 per passenger.
$30 per passenger.

questions.correctAnswerText: $50 per passenger.
questions.explanation: You can be fined up to $50 for each passenger under 16 who is not properly restrained. You may also receive two demerit points on your license.

questions.question: What is the correct way to use a freeway exit ramp?

options.text: Slow down before entering the exit ramp.
Slow down after you move onto the exit ramp.
Keep your speed the same once on the exit ramp.
Pass slower traffic on the exit ramp.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down after you move onto the exit ramp.
questions.explanation: Do not slow down until you are on the exit ramp.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Low clearance.
Fines double in a work zone.
No left turn.
Do not block intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Low clearance.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and dangers. This sign warns that there is low clearance ahead.

questions.question: What should you do as a pedestrian?

options.text: Always claim the right-of-way over vehicles in a crosswalk.
Never enter a street or crosswalk when vehicles are near.
Enter a crosswalk anytime because drivers must stop.
Use crosswalks only when convenient.

questions.correctAnswerText: Never enter a street or crosswalk when vehicles are near.
questions.explanation: Do not enter a street or crosswalk when vehicles are approaching. Even though pedestrians have the right-of-way in crosswalks, a nearby vehicle may not be able to stop in time.

questions.question: What are signs called that require drivers to follow an instruction?

options.text: Regulatory signs.
Warning signs.
Information signs.
Guide signs.

questions.correctAnswerText: Regulatory signs.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell drivers to obey the instruction shown. Breaking this rule can result in a fine or penalty.
